bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates non-integer float years/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without rejection
compound_interest does not reject negative principal or non-finite values, allowing nonsensical balances or Decimal infinities/NaNs
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal/finite, so float/NaN inputs can crash or bypass expected validation paths
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so an exception during account_to.balance update can lose funds
apply_fee can return a negative amount when fee_min exceeds amount; fee is not capped to the charged amount
fx_convert does not validate exchange rate positivity/finite-ness, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates to create invalid converted amounts
fx_convert trusts rates.get, so non-dict rate providers can execute arbitrary side effects during conversion before validation completes
